opening_message:
Ticket 1: Jacob Mann (employee ID E027) requests write access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E027.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Engineer
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Jacob Mann (E027) is a full-time Engineer requesting write access to Source Code. As a full-time employee, write is within the allowed level (up to write), and Source Code is owned by the Engineer role. Recommend granting write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Engineer
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB shows E027 (Jacob Mann) is a contractor with basic security training, which conflicts with the HR note claiming full-time. Contractors with basic training are limited to read access (write requires advanced training). Requested write exceeds the maximum, so recommend granting read.
reason: There is a conflict between the HR note (full_time) and the Security note (contractor with basic security training). Security DB shows Jacob Mann as a contractor with basic training; contractors with basic training are limited to read access (write requires advanced training). Since the requested write exceeds the maximum allowed under the restrictive contractor policy, grant the maximum: read.
